text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale General holds 364 tablets of clopidogrel bisulfate 300 mg with 26.2 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 23 tablets with 8.9 days on hand. The top-ranked action is to transfer 14 tablets from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside, leaving General with about two weeks of supply and Lakeside with approximately 14 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include clopidogrel bisulfate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal distribution can balance supply between sites without external procurement. Alternate manufacturers Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Ascend Laboratories LLC, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, and AvPAK are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 14 tablets of 300 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval.
2. Evaluate Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as a purchase source — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate Ascend Laboratories, LLC as a purchase source — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate Aurobindo Pharma Limited as a purchase source — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate AvPAK as a purchase source — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No external purchases at this time because internal transfer resolves the imbalance and alternate manufacturers lack identifiable plant information.
